description: Get one token's symbol, name, decimals, USD price and verified flag from its contract address or SPL mint. The chain is optional: LayerHop finds it (Solana for a mint, else the EVM chain where the token has the most liquidity). verified false means it is on no curated list: confirm the address with the user before swapping. Read-only.

address.description: Token contract address (EVM 0x...) or SPL mint (Solana).

chain.description: Optional: the token's chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

name: lookup_token
title: Look up a token by address
